Convert a Wings for NONMEM extended control stream to standard NONMEM

Source: R/nm_convert_ctl.R
nm_convert_ctl.Rd

Wings for NONMEM (WFN) supports an extended control stream format where parameter names (e.g. POP_CL, PPV_CL, RUV_PROP) are used directly in model records ($PK, $PRED, $ERROR, $DES) instead of THETA(n), ETA(n), ERR(n). This function parses the parameter names from $THETA, $OMEGA and $SIGMA comment fields and substitutes them back into standard NONMEM syntax, producing a control stream compatible with direct nmfe execution.

Usage

nm_convert_ctl(ctl, out_file = NULL, overwrite = FALSE, verbose = TRUE, ...)

Arguments

ctl

Path to the Wings extended control stream (.ctl). (Formerly ctl_file, still accepted with a warning.)

out_file

Output path for the converted control stream. If NULL (default), the output file is named <run>_converted.ctl in the same directory as ctl.

overwrite

Logical. If TRUE, overwrite out_file if it already exists (default FALSE).

verbose

Logical. If TRUE (default), print a summary of substitutions made.

...

Former argument name, accepted with a warning until version 1.0: ctl_file (now ctl).

Value

Invisibly returns the path to the converted control stream.

Details

The conversion follows the WFN specification:

  • Parameter names are extracted from the first non-numeric word after the ; comment delimiter in each $THETA, $OMEGA and $SIGMA line.

  • Names are substituted by THETA(n), ETA(n) and ERR(n) in model records ($PK, $PRED, $ERROR, $DES, $AES).

  • Once a name appears on the left-hand side of an assignment, it is no longer substituted on subsequent right-hand sides (WFN rule).

  • $OMEGA BLOCK structures are handled correctly.

See also

nm_run

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Convert a WFN extended control stream
out <- nm_convert_ctl("C:/analyses/run001_wfn.ctl")

# Then run with nmpilot
log <- nm_run(
  ctl          = out,
  nmfe_path    = "C:/nm76g64/run/nmfe76.bat",
  analysis_dir = "C:/analyses"
)
} # }
